notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.0 - Português BR!
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 1.1.0
[b]Português BR![/b] Balance tweaks! Bug fixes! Spelling corrections! 
Presenting our very first Lan Party Adventures patch.

[b]New Languages[/b]
Português BR

[b]General Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Mouse dissapearing bug in ethernet minigame and microscopes.
[*] Multiple Window Resolution Displays: now you can play in windowed, fullscreen and windowed fullscreen.
[*] Level 4 Password Bug: a few players reported a bug regarding passwords in level 4 (Comic Store), this has been fixed.
[*] Sandbox Localization: almost all assets are localized now.
[*] Colission bugs in Level 3 (School): some awkward collisions with decoration objects have been fixed.
[*] Unexpected crashes.
[/list]

[b]UX[/b]
We have also added some UX help for players in some levels:
[list]
[*] Level 7 (Alter's HQ): additional password hints for modem in 1st floor and basement
[*] Level 2 (Pedro's house):  Jake's call hints.
[*] We also changed some texts in other languages.
[/list]

notes.title: LAN Party Adventures releases on September 18! Wishlist Now!
notes.notes: [p]Hey, hey, friends, how are you all doing? 👋[/p][p][/p][p]We're happy to finally reveal that [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3566720/LAN_Party_Adventures/"]LAN Party Adventures[/url] is set to release on [b]September 18[/b]. That's it! The game will be in your hands in a month. A bit crazy as we're still developing it, right? 📅[/p][p][/p][p]But the time has come, all is (nearly) set, and someone has to start investigating [b]WHY PEDRO HAS GONE MISSING in our Escape Room-Style Detective Sim[/b]. Hope you guys are ready...[/p][p][/p][p]On top of the main adventure that will put your [b]detective skills[/b] to the test, we just revealed more details about [b]Sandbox Mode, in which you will create your own fully customizable LAN Parties![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Our very own [b]Sebastián Lulli (Game Director)[/b] prepared [b]a video explaining what's the Sandbox Mode about.[/b] Watch it below and get a small glimpse of it.[/p][previewyoutube="v9uvHO9dgCc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]A lot to digest, right? Just don't forget: [b][i]LAN Party Adventures[/i][/b] will be available here, on Steam, on [b]September 18[/b]. Just [b]give us your wishlist[/b], will you? We really appreciate it.[/p][p][/p][p]And now, time to go back to our dev room and finish the game (don't worry, is nearly ready 🖥️)[/p]
